真感受，是表演的灵魂和根基，也是AI无法逾越的边界: True feeling is the soul and foundation of performance, and also a boundary that AI cannot cross.

伴随着人工智能（AI）技术的不断成熟，从文字创作到视频生成，我们发现AI也样样都: With the continued maturation of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, from text creation to video generation, we find that AI can do everything.
回答这个问题之前，需要先回答另一个关键问题：AI生成的文艺和人类千百年来的文艺是: Before answering this question, we need to first answer another key question: Are AI-generated literature and art the same thing as humanity's literature and art over thousands of years?
人们对AI创作这个现象的讨论很热，但对AI创作作品的讨论几乎没有: There is much discussion about the phenomenon of AI creation, but almost no discussion about AI-created works.
AI像是一个没有代表作品的艺术家，大家只知道AI能创作，但谁也记不住AI创作过什: AI is like an artist with no representative works; everyone knows AI can create, but no one can remember what AI has created.
比如，谁能背出一首AI写的诗: For example, who can recite a poem written by AI?
AI诗作在数量上恐怕已经超过人类诗作总和，但还没有迎来自己的李白与杜甫: AI poetry may have already surpassed the total sum of human poetry in quantity, but it has yet to see its own Li Bai and Du Fu.
还可以换一种问法，我们谁被AI创作的作品感动落泪过: We could rephrase it another way: who has been moved to tears by an AI-created work?
谁在AI作品中真切感受到自己生活中的困惑: Who has truly felt their own life's confusions in an AI work?
AI写出的痛苦与欢乐并无意义，它没有真的痛苦或欢乐过，而只是一种数字化的模拟: The pain and joy written by AI are meaningless; it has never truly experienced pain or joy, but only a digital simulation of it.
AI可以模拟创作者的大脑，但无法模拟创作者的心灵: AI can simulate the brain of a creator, but cannot simulate the soul of a creator.
在这个意义上，文艺的魅力不会因AI的出现而消逝，反而会迎来更为广泛的传播: In this sense, the charm of literature and art will not vanish with the advent of AI; instead, it will see even broader dissemination.
借助AI，过往的“读者”，正在大规模地转化为“作者”: With the help of AI, former 'readers' are undergoing large-scale transformation into 'authors'.
以往是在他人作品里间接地感受生命经验，现在有可能借助AI及其他技术手段直接地表达: In the past, people indirectly experienced life through others' works; now it is possible to directly express one's own experiences with the help of AI and other technical means.
这需要一套更精密地驾驭AI的方法: This requires a more sophisticated method of mastering AI.
未来文艺创作的一个门槛，可能是深入掌握提示词的写法，将AI驯化为一个更为高级的键: One possible threshold for future literary and artistic creation may be deeply mastering the writing of prompts, taming AI into a more advanced keyboard, so that it participates in creation in the sense of a tool rather than as an agent.
因此，AI时代新大众文艺的出现恰逢其时，有其深刻的时代逻辑: Therefore, the emergence of new mass literature and art in the AI era is timely and has profound logic of the times.
AI不是文艺创作的取代者，如果运用得当，它有助于降低文艺创作门槛，传播文艺创作技: AI is not a replacement for literary and artistic creation; if used properly, it can help lower the threshold for literary and artistic creation, spread techniques of literary and artistic creation, and enable the masses to express their vibrant lives through literature and art.
